summary: Iteration 2: Tested AI chat + dynamic left panel. Backend: 19/19 pytest pass (added 4 AI assistant tests covering single-turn, multi-turn context, intent sanitization, empty history). Frontend: All critical AI flows pass — /ai loads, Claude Sonnet 4.5 replies, intent mapping drives left-panel transitions (skilled-nursing, book, referral), chip clicks re-send, appointment form POSTs successfully, mode toggle switches routes, session id persists in localStorage across reload. One real UX bug: send button is visually overlapped by the 'Made with Emergent' badge (click intercepted); Enter-key submit works fine. ChatPanel also does not rehydrate message history from backend on reload — only the session id persists, not the visible conversation.

ui_bugs.issue: The '[data-testid=chat-send-btn]' button is visually positioned at bottom-right of the chat panel and is overlapped/intercepted by the fixed 'Made with Emergent' badge, so pointer clicks on the send icon do not register. Pressing Enter in the input works because form onSubmit fires. Users on mobile/desktop who tap the icon will experience a broken send.

integration_issues.issue: On reload, localStorage 'careplus-session' is preserved (confirmed) but ChatPanel starts with messages=[] — it never calls GET /api/assistant/history/{session_id} on mount to rehydrate the prior conversation. User sees a fresh chat even though backend retains the full thread. PRD states 'conversation history persists' via the session id; UX-wise messages should repopulate.

issues: Send button is covered by the persistent 'Made with Emergent' badge at bottom-right. Either shift the chat input form left/up on the chat panel, or account for the badge's safe area.

action_items: Move or resize the send button / chat input row so it is not covered by the bottom-right 'Made with Emergent' badge (e.g., add right padding ~140px on the form when viewport is desktop, or raise form padding-bottom).

In ChatPanel useEffect, after resolving sessionRef, fetch GET ${API}/assistant/history/${session_id} and hydrate `messages` so reload preserves the visible conversation (backend already persists messages and endpoint works).
critical_code_review_comments: ChatPanel.jsx: hidden md:flex for aside but mobile renders a duplicate ChatPanel below (two instances with the same ref). The second mount will overwrite chatRef.current — acceptable because only one is mounted at a time via media query, but both hit useEffect and set sessionRef independently; minor.
server.py assistant_chat: on LLM error throws 502 — good. But when _extract_json fails, reply falls back to raw string which may still include code fences; consider stripping.
ChatPanel never calls /api/assistant/history on mount → UX regression w.r.t. PRD wording on persistence.
DynamicView service:<slug> view test id uses colon which still works with CSS attr selectors; fine but unusual. Keep consistent.
AppointmentForm/ReferralForm duplicate logic already in pages/*.jsx counterparts — DRY candidate; extract into a shared form component.

success_rate.frontend: 90% (all critical AI flows pass; send-button click and history rehydration flagged)

test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this app.
seed_data_creation: TEST_ prefixed records created across contacts/referrals/surveys/appointments/chat_messages during pytest + playwright runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend AI chat verified end-to-end (Claude Sonnet 4.5 via emergentintegrations). Intent mapping verified for 'Tell me about skilled nursing' → service:skilled-nursing, 'Book an appointment' → action:book_appointment, 'I want to refer a patient' → action:submit_referral — all transitioned the left panel correctly. Tests use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env. Two outstanding issues to retest after main-agent fix: (1) send button click not intercepted by Emergent badge, (2) ChatPanel rehydrates history on mount. Use Enter-key to send in playwright as a reliable workaround. LLM latency is ~3-8s — keep waits generous (>=12s after sending).
rca of the issue: Send-button click regression is caused by z-index / stacking order — the platform-level 'Made with Emergent' iframe badge is fixed bottom-right and sits above the chat form. Fix is purely CSS/layout on the frontend (right-padding or bottom-padding on the chat form container). History rehydration is missing — ChatPanel's sessionRef useEffect reads localStorage but never issues GET /api/assistant/history/{session_id}; add a second useEffect that runs after sessionRef resolves and setMessages() from the returned messages array (map role/content).
